app_store.name: Veloxis Download Accelerator
app_store.subtitle: Multi Stream File Downloader
app_store.promotional_text: Accelerate large transfers with dynamic multi-stream segmentation, video grabber tools, and automatic broken link resumption.
app_store.description:
Veloxis is a high-throughput download accelerator built for speed, stability, and quiet reliability.

By dynamically splitting files into parallel HTTP range streams, Veloxis maximizes bandwidth utilization and finishes large downloads significantly faster.

Key Capabilities:
- Dynamic Multi-Connection Slicing: Splits files into up to 32 parallel segments with dynamic chunk rebalancing.
- Video and Audio Stream Grabber: Detects online video and audio streams with multiple resolution choices.
- Silent Background Operation: Files save quietly to your disk with zero focus-stealing popups.
- Resilient Broken Link Recovery: Easily update expired cloud URLs without losing already downloaded chunks.
- High-Precision Telemetry: Real-time speed throttling, connection visualizer, and queue management.

Built for power users who demand maximum performance and zero interruptions.

google_play.title: Veloxis Download Accelerator
google_play.short_description: Accelerate transfers with parallel streams and silent background downloads.
google_play.full_description:
Veloxis is a high-throughput download accelerator designed for speed, stability, and silent background efficiency.

Veloxis splits large files into dynamic parallel streams, saturating your internet bandwidth to deliver maximum transfer speed without interrupting your active workflow.

Core Features:

• Dynamic Multi-Connection Engine
Splits downloads into simultaneous HTTP range streams with automatic chunk rebalancing when servers throttle individual connections.

• Video and Media Stream Sniffer
Instantly captures streaming media across supported websites with one-click resolution and format selection.

• Silent Background Transfers
Zero modal nag screens and zero focus-stealing dialogs. Files save directly to disk with native system alerts.

• Resilient Link Recovery
Update expired cloud URLs without restarting your download or losing progress.

• Bandwidth Scheduling & Throttling
Set custom transfer speeds or queue large files for automated night-time downloading.
